description: Agents as VS Code extensions on macOS, matched by extension id, and one JetBrains plugin by its directory.
why: Each agent on macOS, where nothing proved one before. The extension id is each agent's only witness here, and it is the same on every platform. The Amazon Q plugin row is pinned because must_find passes on its VS Code extension alone, and the row is what proves jetbrains.sql reads plugins on macOS. `forbid` names Cline, whose name Roo Code's id `rooveterinaryinc.roo-cline` contains, the control 85-linux-vscode-agents holds on Linux.
